page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with 56 dedicated physical cores and 56 vCPUs, operating at a base speed of 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The CPU configuration features a 1.0 thread-per-core ratio and a 48 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 346.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.18 GB of RAM per core. For acceleration, it includes a single NVIDIA A10 GPU from the Ampere family with 24 GB of VRAM.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong performance in multi-threaded decompression and cryptographic operations, with a Passmark CPU score of 51481.37 and a bzip3 multi-threaded decompression speed of 262.06 GB/sec. The integrated NVIDIA A10 GPU delivers top-tier LLM inference speeds, processing 9738.91 tokens per second for prompts and 457.19 tokens per second for text generation on a small 135M model. For a medium 7B model, it achieves 2464.01 tokens per second for prompt processing and 89.85 tokens per second for text generation. Memory bandwidth for large uncached blocks is measured at 129.14 GB/sec for reads and 51.84 GB/sec for writes.

A key architectural tradeoff is the complete absence of local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. The network baseline bandwidth is rated at 16 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of dedicated Intel Xeon cores and a dedicated NVIDIA Ampere GPU provides a balanced resource density for specialized workloads without the overhead of multi-GPU configurations. This server is highly suited for deep learning inference, medium-scale language model execution, database operations, and high-throughput cryptographic processing.
